sentences.text:
Ms. Pragya Pandey, Advocate has filed her vakalatnama on behalf of the informant, the same is
taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and Ms. Pragya Pandey, counsel for the informant.
Perused the material placed on record.

3. This application under section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.117 of 2024, under sections 498A, 304B, 323, 506, 34 I.P.C., and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mandi,
District Saharanpur.

Naima vs State Of U.P. on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153245016/
1

4. After arguing the matter at some length, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this application with liberty to the applicant to surrender before the concered court and apply for regular bail.
5. In view of the above, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
